Ranking activity rules
  1. Daily rankings start at 00:00 local time. Rewards are paid at 10:00 local time on the following day.
  2. Weekly rankings run from Monday at 00:00 through Sunday at 24:00 local time. Rewards are paid the following Monday at 10:00 local time.
  3. Monthly rankings run from 00:00 on the first day through 24:00 on the last day of the month. Rewards are paid on the first day of the following month at 10:00 local time.
  4. Ranking bonuses require 5× turnover before withdrawal to a bank card.
  5. Players must bind their mobile phone number to receive rewards.
  6. Betting amounts from certain games may be excluded from ranking reward calculations.
Ranking terms and conditions
  1. Provide a mobile phone number and bank account details before applying for rewards. Phone numbers, IP addresses and bank details must match the player’s region and profile. Abnormal activity may void winnings or profits.
  2. Players using multiple or fraudulent accounts will be disqualified from promotional events, and those accounts will be frozen.
  3. Read the event terms and conditions carefully before participating.
Reward wheel activity
  1. The event has four wheel types: Silver, Gold, Diamond and Special. Recharge to unlock different levels; higher levels offer larger rewards.
  2. Each draw has a 100% chance of receiving a reward.
  3. Rewards are deposited directly into your wallet.
  4. Bonuses require 5× turnover before withdrawal.
  5. Contact customer service for questions about the activity and its terms.

Daily Double Bonus

Your tier is based on yesterday’s total recharge. Claim the free reward for the qualifying tier and complete the required deposit for the additional paid reward. If yesterday’s recharge did not reach the minimum tier, no reward is available today.
